description: 2x1 BITMAPV5HEADER with LCS_CALIBRATED_RGB, sRGB primaries in the endpoints and gamma 2.2
notes: Endpoints are FXPT2DOT30 (raw / 2^30) and gamma is unsigned 16.16 (raw / 65536), so 2.2 arrives as 0x00023333. Both are reported and neither is applied: the pixels come out in whatever space they went in, because a half-applied colour transform is undetectable downstream and undoable by nobody.
